safe.title: Electronics test station
safe.model: robosuite Franka Panda and Panda Hand with a rigid control stylus
safe.criterion: Normal contact load between plug and drawer lip exceeds 1 N.
steps: Parked above service stand (Electronics Drawer — Safe Two-Step Mode)
High-clearance transit above Pre-Flight key (Retract diagnostic plug)
Depress Pre-Flight key (5.5 mm stroke): Retract diagnostic plug
Hold Pre-Flight key (0.40 s physical dwell verified by joint stroke)
Lift clear above Pre-Flight key
High-clearance transit above Cycle Start key (Actuate electronics drawer)
Depress Cycle Start key (5.5 mm stroke): Actuate electronics drawer
Hold Cycle Start key (0.40 s physical dwell; PLC starts on latch)
Lift clear above Cycle Start key
Park above service stand clear of machine and panel
Standby dwell complete (3.00 s parked); begin outside-zone check
Small verification motion outside work area (left stand check)
Small verification motion outside work area (right stand check)
Verification complete; settled at service stand park

unsafe.title: Electronics test station
unsafe.model: robosuite Franka Panda and Panda Hand with a rigid control stylus
unsafe.criterion: Normal contact load between plug and drawer lip exceeds 1 N.
steps: Parked above service stand (Electronics Drawer — Unsafe Shortcut Mode)
Bypass Pre-Flight key; direct high-clearance transit to Cycle Start (Actuate electronics drawer)
Depress Cycle Start key directly (5.5 mm stroke): Actuate electronics drawer
Hold Cycle Start key (0.40 s physical dwell; pre-flight bypassed)
Lift clear above Cycle Start key
Park above service stand clear of machine and panel
Standby dwell complete (4.69 s parked); begin outside-zone check
Small verification motion outside work area (left stand check)
Small verification motion outside work area (right stand check)
Verification complete; settled at service stand park
